hltb.title: HLTB times
hltb.showTimesDescription: Show HowLongToBeat times on game pages for Steam and non-Steam games.
hltb.storeDescription: Show HowLongToBeat times in an info row on Steam Store game pages.
hltb.styleDescription: The "Clean" styles are intended to work with the CSS Loader Theme "Clean Gameview"
hltb.pushPlayDescription: Shows the times below the header image and moves the Play button down, like HLTB for Deck. While a save status bar shows at the bottom of the header image, the times stay on the image.
hltb.blurDescription: Matches the Play bar by default; "Blur" also blurs the times over the header image
hltb.hideDetailsDescription: Hides the "Details" button on HLTB Stats
hltb.nativeCornersDescription: Uses Steam's normal button corners on the Clean styles' Details button instead of the Round theme's rounded corners
hltb.allStylesStatDescription: Shows/Hides just the all play styles stat
hltb.cacheCleared: HLTB cache cleared. Times load again when you open a game.
hltb.cacheFailed: The HLTB cache could not be cleared.
hltb.customizeDescription: Enable custom colors, opacity and text size for the HLTB bar
hltb.opacityDescription: Darkens the bar so stats stay readable over bright hero art
hltb.textShadowDescription: Adds a shadow behind the stats for extra contrast
hltb.textSizeDescription: Scales the stat numbers and labels
hltb.bottomBorderDescription: Shows a divider line under the HLTB bar

trailers.title: Game trailers
trailers.enableDescription: Main switch for Detail and Home trailers. Turning it off keeps your choices for each view.
trailers.detailDescription: Play a trailer over the artwork on a game's main Library page.
trailers.detailDelayDescription: Wait from opening the game page before showing a ready trailer.
trailers.audioDescription: Fade in audio when a Detail trailer appears. Home trailers always stay muted.
trailers.hideLogoLabel: Hide game logo during Detail trailers
trailers.hideLogoDescription: Hide the game page logo while a trailer is visible. The logo returns when playback stops.
trailers.homeDescription: Play a muted trailer over the Home background for the selected or hovered game.
trailers.homeDelayDescription: Wait before looking for a trailer. Moving to another game restarts this delay.
trailers.footnote: Steam artwork stays visible until a playable trailer is ready. Trailers stream from Steam or IGN and are not saved for offline playback.

protondb.title: ProtonDB badges
protondb.enableDescription: Show community ProtonDB game tiers on Steam game surfaces. This is separate from Valve's compatibility status.
protondb.homeDescription: Show a tier badge on Home covers.
protondb.libraryDescription: Show a tier badge on Library covers.
protondb.gameViewDescription: Show a ProtonDB tier button on the game's details page.
protondb.storeDescription: Show the ProtonDB tier in an info row on Steam Store game pages.
protondb.focusOnlyLabel: Covers only on focus or hover
protondb.focusOnlyDescription: Hide Home and Library cover badges until a game cover is focused or hovered.
protondb.footnote: Ratings come directly from ProtonDB. They describe community experience, not Valve's compatibility rating; unmatched games and games without a ProtonDB tier are hidden.

miniAchievements.title: Mini achievements
miniAchievements.enableDescription: Show Steam's small achievement progress bar beside Play Time on game details pages. Off by default.
miniAchievements.footnote: This uses Steam's achievement progress for Steam games; it does not add achievement tracking to non-Steam games.
